claude_proposed_widenings.name: LevelAxis.turns_elapsed
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The damage counter starts at 12d6 and increases by 1d6 each turn the spell remains active. This is a runtime accumulator driven by turns elapsed during concentration — not a cast-time slot level, character level, or class level. LevelAxis has no 'turns elapsed' variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell's base damage is 12d6, and the damage increases by 1d6 whenever your turn ends and the spell hasn't ended.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_spell_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The bead's explosion — the save_gate + damage — fires specifically when the spell ends (naturally after 1 minute, or triggered early by touch/throw). Currently OngoingTrigger has no 'on spell end' variant; all triggers fire during the spell's active window, not at its termination.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When the spell ends, the bead explodes, and each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_creature_touches_attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: A creature physically touching the bead (the spell's attachment point) opens a Dex save window. This is distinct from all existing OngoingTrigger variants: it is not a turn-start, attack-hit, movement, area-entry, or caster-action trigger — it is contact with the bead itself.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If a creature touches the glowing bead before the spell ends, that creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffect.creature_throw_attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On a successful touch save, the creature may throw the bead up to 40 feet. If the thrown bead enters a creature's space or collides with a solid object, the spell ends (triggering the explosion). This is creature-agency repositioning of the spell's attachment point with collision-triggered spell termination — not covered by reposition_attachment (which is a caster action, not a creature-agency throw with collision semantics).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a successful save, the creature can throw the bead up to 40 feet. If the thrown bead enters a creature's space or collides with a solid object, the spell ends, and the bead explodes.
